items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh actually Shep had some rivalry with me, cause it was the time... And the record company was pittin’ us against each other.

ctx.x: So anyway, he’s playin’... And so, that night... Oh actually Shep had some rivalry with me, cause it was the time... And the record company was pittin’ us against each other. There was a guy named Frank Kofsky, I don’t know if you ever ran into that name.
